description: This is a unit test source file for the Tasks module in a SuiteCRM-based project. It contains multiple test methods to verify the behavior of the Task bean, including creation, saving, deletion, data retrieval, and ACL permissions.

classes.name: TaskTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Task bean in the Tasks module, testing creation, persistence, deletion, data retrieval, and permissions.
